descriptions.d25j_switch_parts_8017b15c: Holds the shape under the key at +4, calls 0x8017b6dc, then finds part +124 (flag set) or part +120 (flag clear) in the shape's list; on a hit notifies the shape through 0x801ef380 and 0x801ef174 with the other part and clears (flag set) or sets to part +120 (flag clear) the reference at +20 of part +124; returns 0, or 0x80004005 on a miss.
